clusters.headline: Nvidia Investigates CEO Following Admission Of Affair With Spy Suspect
aiSummaryBullets: Nvidia's board of directors initiated an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following reports of a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.
Jensen Huang confirmed an extramarital affair and issued an apology, acknowledging the potential impact on his family and the organization.

clusters.headline: Hong Kong Activist Joshua Wong Sentenced To Ten Years In Prison
aiSummaryBullets: Hong Kong courts have sentenced prominent activist Joshua Wong to ten years in prison.
The sentencing follows conviction on charges related to collusion with foreign forces.
